n.exploreUrl:
<js>
var result = [];
function push(t, u, w){
	result.push({"title": t, "url": u, "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": (w || 0.4)}});
}
function sUrl(extra, sort){
	return 'https://api.newlucifer.com/s/Index/search,{"method":"POST","body":"keywords=%25&page={{page}}&limit=20&sort=' + (sort || 0) + (extra ? '&' + extra : '') + '&token={{source.get("token")}}"}';
}
function kwUrl(kw, sort){
	return 'https://api.newlucifer.com/s/Index/search,{"method":"POST","body":"keywords=' + encodeURIComponent(kw) + '&page={{page}}&limit=20&sort=' + (sort || 1) + '&token={{source.get("token")}}"}';
}
var groups = ["首页","我的收藏","性向","类型","分级","状态","字数","更新","区域","性质","标签","排序","热门CP","热门原作"];
var tab = infoMap["发现分组"] || "首页";
result.push({"title":"发现分组","type":"select","chars":groups,"default":tab,"action":"java.refreshExplore()","style":{"layout_flexGrow":1,"layout_flexBasisPercent":1}});

if(tab == "首页"){
	// 国产/欧美/亚洲 × 不限/影视/动漫/小说/游戏/其他
	var areas = ["国产", "欧美", "亚洲"];
	var gs = [["不限",0],["影视",1],["动漫",2],["小说",3],["游戏",4],["其他",5]];
	for(var a=1;a<=3;a++){
		for(var g=0;g<gs.length;g++){
			push("🏠 " + areas[a-1] + "·" + gs[g][0], 'https://api.newlucifer.com/s/Index/index_list,{"method":"POST","body":"page={{page}}&limit=20&group=' + gs[g][1] + '&area=' + a + '&token={{source.get("token")}}"}', 0.4);
		}
	}
}else if(tab == "我的收藏"){
	push("⭐ 我的收藏（需登录）", 'https://api.newlucifer.com/s/User/article_collection_list,{"method":"POST","body":"token={{source.get("token")}}"}', 1);
}else if(tab == "性向"){
	var so = [["BL","1"],["GL","2"],["BG","3"],["GB","6"],["无CP","4"],["混合","5"]];
	for(var i=0;i<so.length;i++){ push("❤️ " + so[i][0], sUrl("sexual_orientation=" + so[i][1]), 0.4); }
}else if(tab == "类型"){
	push("🎭 原著向", sUrl("type=1"), 0.4);
	push("🎭 AU向", sUrl("type=2"), 0.4);
}else if(tab == "分级"){
	var gr = [["全年龄","1"],["辅导级","2"],["限制级","3"]];
	for(var i=0;i<gr.length;i++){ push("📊 " + gr[i][0], sUrl("grade=" + gr[i][1]), 0.4); }
}else if(tab == "状态"){
	var st = [["连载","1"],["完结","2"],["停更","3"]];
	for(var i=0;i<st.length;i++){ push("📌 " + st[i][0], sUrl("finish_status=" + st[i][1]), 0.4); }
}else if(tab == "字数"){
	var wc = [["1万以下","1"],["5万以下","2"],["10万以下","3"],["10万以上","4"]];
	for(var i=0;i<wc.length;i++){ push("📝 " + wc[i][0], sUrl("words_number=" + wc[i][1]), 0.4); }
}else if(tab == "更新"){
	var tm = [["3个月内","1"],["半年内","2"],["1年内","3"],["1年以上","4"]];
	for(var i=0;i<tm.length;i++){ push("🕒 " + tm[i][0], sUrl("time=" + tm[i][1]), 0.4); }
}else if(tab == "区域"){
	var ar = [["国产","1"],["欧美","2"],["亚洲","3"]];
	for(var i=0;i<ar.length;i++){ push("🗺 " + ar[i][0], sUrl("area=" + ar[i][1]), 0.4); }
}else if(tab == "性质"){
	var pt = [["原创","1"],["转载","2"],["原创翻译","3"],["转载翻译","4"]];
	for(var i=0;i<pt.length;i++){ push("🏷 " + pt[i][0], sUrl("publish_type=" + pt[i][1]), 0.4); }
}else if(tab == "标签"){
	try{
		var tk = source.get("token") || "";
		if(tk){
			var hl = String(java.ajax("https://api.newlucifer.com/s/Index/hot_label?token=" + tk) || "");
			var hd = JSON.parse(hl);
			if(hd && hd.data){
				for(var i=0;i<hd.data.length && i<20;i++){ push("# " + hd.data[i].name, sUrl("label=" + hd.data[i].id), 0.4); }
			}
		}
	}catch(e){}
}else if(tab == "排序"){
	var sr = [["最新回复","0"],["作品点击","1"],["作品赞赏","2"],["最新发布","3"]];
	for(var i=0;i<sr.length;i++){ push("🔀 " + sr[i][0], sUrl("", sr[i][1]), 0.4); }
}else if(tab == "热门CP" || tab == "热门原作"){
	try{
		var tk = source.get("token") || "";
		if(tk){
			var rk = String(java.ajax('https://api.newlucifer.com/s/Index/ranking,{"method":"POST","body":"area=1&group=1&hot=0&token=' + tk + '"}') || "");
			var rd = JSON.parse(rk);
			if(rd && rd.data){
				if(tab == "热门CP"){
					var hc = rd.data.hot_cp || [];
					for(var i=0;i<hc.length && i<8;i++){ push("🔥 " + hc[i].name, kwUrl(hc[i].name), 0.4); }
				}else{
					var ho = rd.data.hot_original_name || [];
					for(var i=0;i<ho.length && i<8;i++){ push("🔥 " + ho[i].name, kwUrl(ho[i].name), 0.4); }
				}
			}
		}
	}catch(e){}
}
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
